scope: Sum of returned hourly allocation groups, not priced billing or normalized savings

readiness_checkpoint.not_a_usage_denominator: Checkpoint is later than the usage cutoff and includes initial predictions generated before the window.

limitations: Recent hours can be incomplete because of ingestion lag.
An absent application/hour group does not independently prove zero usage.
Aggregate instance-minutes are not wall time for one instance or one job.
This window is not a complete UTC billing day and does not isolate identical workloads.
No causal 50-percent cost reduction or live idle-SIGTERM result is established.
